{{Top|leg}}
'''Chancellor's Prerogative''' was a legal claim that could be invoked by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in order to supersede the normal conventions of a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] session. Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] once claimed Chancellor's Prerogative during the debate over the [[Enhanced Security and Enforcement Act]] in order to allow [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] to address his colleagues on the matter.
